thread:
Iris (Product): Quick thread to finalize "mini" observability MVP scope for console. Customers want: per-route cost, sampled traces, and error grouping. We need launch gates, minimal UX, and ops guardrails. Please confirm feasibility and gate numbers.

Noah (Eng-runtime): Feasible with constraints. Plan: emit lightweight events from runtime, async pipeline for traces. Sampling by default 0.5%.

Rhea (Eng-SRE): Ops must include per-org daily caps, retention tiers (7/30/90), and surge alerts. We'll require a load-test before beta.

Evan (Design): Proposed UI: Cost card (route breakdown), Trace panel (sample list + link), Error card (grouped with sample toggle). Minimal mobile-friendly layout.

Sam (Data): Metric schema: tags = org_id, route, model, variant; fields = tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, status. Cost calc = tokens * unit_cost + infra_est. Backfill supported via opt-in batch job.

Iris (Product): Suggested launch gates: 1) cost variance <7% vs billing for beta orgs; 2) trace capture adds <12% p99 latency; 3) error groups show top-5 with at least one sample each. Beta = 3 customers + internal.

Noah (Eng-runtime): Agree. Implementation notes: nonblocking hook, async uploader, dynamic sampling (route/latency/customer). Example config: {"default":0.005, "overrides":[{"route":"batch-embed","rate":0.02},{"latency_gt_ms":800,"rate":1.0}] }.

Rhea (Eng-SRE): Rollback triggers: sustained p99 increase >15% or unforeseen cost spike >20% above forecast. Also abort if trace ingestion ops exceed autoscale budget.

Evan (Design): UX acceptance: drilldown from cost item -> traces/errors; redaction toggle for samples; compact table for large orgs. I'll drop mocks by EOD.

Sam (Data): Backfill estimate: ~2 CPU-hours per 50M requests. Will gate with a backfill approval flag.

ci-bot: Created ticket OBS-MINI-1: "Console mini-observability MVP" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-MINI-1

Iris (Product): Thanks team. Action items: Noah/Rhea -> ETA + perf test plan tomorrow, Sam -> schema + backfill runbook, Evan -> mocks. We'll reconvene after RFCs.

Noah (Eng-runtime): On it.

Rhea (Eng-SRE): Adding sizing doc.

Evan (Design): Mock link incoming.

Sam (Data): Publishing schema now.

Iris (Product): Closing thread for now — will open follow-ups for RFC and beta invites. :white_check_mark:
